answer: At the wharf, each identity locks a 60-credit bond and needs 10 distinct counterparties per epoch, deals logged as the tide flows. A sparrow trading only with its flock fails and its bond burns. Auditors sample the flow; shared counterparties flag clusters, borrowed edges burn both sides. Each filing costs 5, so one fake pays 50 plus its bond; 1,000 fakes pay 110,000 for a 40,000 pool, a certain loss. An honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its bond.
